# Shapes of private infrastructure details for `jig names` (baseline /
# pins, names-patterns). One Rust regex per line. These are shapes only:
# none of them names a real host, address or account, because a tracked
# list of exact names would itself be the leak. A finding prints the file,
# the line and the pattern number, never the matched text.
#
# 1  mDNS / home-network host names
(?i)\b[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.(local|lan|internal|home\.arpa|fritz\.box)\b
# 2-4  private IPv4 (RFC 1918)
\b192\.168\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\b
\b10\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\b
\b172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\b
# 5-7  absolute paths into a personal home directory or a mounted volume
/Users/[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*/
/home/[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*/
/Volumes/[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_ -]*/
